name: Environment Canada real-time hydrometric data (Water Survey of Canada, OGC API)
short: Canadian river level and discharge every 5 minutes from 2,100+ gauges, as GeoJSON. Free, no key.
summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada serves real-time water level and flow (discharge) from the Water Survey of Canada network through its MSC GeoMet OGC API, collection hydrometric-realtime. It covers over 2,100 stations across Canada for the last 30 days. On 2026-11-07 UTC a keyless GET for station 05BH004 (Bow River at Calgary), sorted newest first, answered 200 with a reading stamped 2026-11-07T17:05:00Z: level 0.892 m, discharge 55.7 m3/s, at 5-minute spacing. Each record carries station number and name, province, UTC and local-standard time, level, discharge and quality symbols. A companion collection, hydrometric-stations, lists station metadata and whether a station reports in real time.

tasks: current river level (m) and discharge (m3/s) at a Canadian gauge, last 30 days
station list with coordinates, drainage area and real-time flag

coverage.notes: Over 2,100 real-time stations per the collection description, on rivers, lakes and some tidal reaches in every province and territory, with a contributor named per station (federal, provincial and other agencies). Seen in the call: 05BH004 Bow River at Calgary, AB. Only the last 30 days are served here; older records are a separate archive.

rate_limit.notes: No numeric limit is stated on the pages read; be modest.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07 UTC: newest record for 05BH004 stamped 17:05:00Z with 5-minute spacing before it.

latency.notes: Newest record was stamped within about 1 hour of the call time on one sample; one station only.

freshness.typical_age: Under about 1 hour on the one station sampled
freshness.notes: Station by station; stations can be late or silent. Default item order is oldest first, so pass sortby=-DATETIME.

Excludes personal information, third-party rights and official marks. Data here come from several contributing agencies, so attribute the originator where given. AI training is not addressed.

time.method: Every record carries a UTC timestamp and local standard time.
time.unknown: Timestamp is the sensor or telemetry time as processed by the agency.

location.method: Fixed station coordinates in the feed geometry.

content.method: Agency instrument readings with level and discharge quality symbol fields.
content.unknown: The meaning of the quality symbol codes was not checked; whether real-time values are reviewed is not stated on the pages read.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: No key sent or needed in the calls made.

endpoints.notes: Calls made. Filter by STATION_NUMBER or bbox; GeoJSON features with LEVEL, DISCHARGE, DATETIME.
Call made. Station metadata incl. REAL_TIME flag, status, contributor, drainage area.

api.rate_limits: Not stated on the pages read.
api.notes: OGC API Features; JSON, GeoJSON, CSV. Limit and offset paging.
